item.text: summarise the notes
Looking that up for you.
explain the math behind the retry budget

The backoff is a geometric series, so the total wait has a closed form.

$$
\sum_{k=0}^{n-1} b \cdot r^k = b \cdot \frac{1 - r^n}{1 - r}
$$

With $b = 250$ ms and $r = 2$, five attempts wait $3.75$ s in total.

That is the same ceiling the guide quotes, and the plan costs $12 a month either way.
